title: Professional Certificate Course in Strategies for the Promotion of Health and Social Care
description: It aims to equip students with knowledge and skills to develop effective strategies to promote health and social care among individuals and communities.
longDescription: Understand the historical evolution of health promotion and its importance in healthcare Identify the targets and approaches of health promotion and various health promotion strategies Learn about the do’s and do nots to reduce the risk of sudden infant death Gain knowledge on the ten-year tobacco control strategy for Northern Ireland Understand the significance of the new office for health promotion in driving the improvement of the nation's health Study the national issues of public health, including pensions, demographic hurdles, and Brexit Explore ethical issues in health promotion, such as digital gaps and obligations to promote health effectively and efficiently Learn about global issues in healthcare, including pandemics, environmental factors, economic disparities, political factors, and major challenges faced in the healthcare industry in 2021. The aim of a course on Strategies for the Promotion of Health and Social Care is to equip students with knowledge and skills to develop effective strategies to promote health and social care among individuals and communities. The course aims to help students understand the key determinants of health and social care and the various strategies that can be employed to promote them. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn the following:
courseDetails: A course on Strategies for the Promotion of Health and Social Care will cover a range of topics related to health promotion and social care. Students will develop an understanding of the social determinants of health and explore the different strategies that can be used to promote health and social care. The course will also provide students with knowledge and skills to evaluate the effectiveness of health promotion strategies and understand the ethical considerations involved. Additionally, the course will foster critical thinking and problem-solving skills in the development of health promotion strategies, with a focus on adapting to changing circumstances and emerging challenges.
